basics.name: Haeryun Jung
basics.label: Biomechanics & Sports Engineering Researcher
basics.summary: Researcher specializing in Biomechanics and Sports Engineering with a focus on Adaptive Sports. Experienced in analyzing human movement data, processing biomechanical signals, and applying machine learning techniques to sports engineering.

work.name: MTVS / Spatial X
work.summary: Spatial X – XR Content for Disability Awareness through Spatial Perception Technology
highlights: Developed immersive XR content for disability awareness using **Unity and C#**.
Designed interactive experiences incorporating **spatial audio, spatial perception, and user interaction**.
Implemented XR-based training and assessment features to provide users with an experiential understanding of sensory and spatial challenges.

work.name: Korea Institute of Sport Science (KISS)
work.summary: Sports Biomechanics & Performance Analysis Team, Sports Science Research Center
highlights: Conducted **performance analysis and performance prediction** for elite Paralympic athletes.
Performed biomechanical analyses across multiple para-sports to support athlete performance and coaching.
Developed and applied **sports science technologies and data-driven solutions** for Paralympic training and competition.
Supported field-based performance monitoring, biomechanical assessment, and technology implementation for national-level para-athletes.

work.name: Kookmin University
highlights: Collected, processed, and analyzed **biomechanical and human movement data**.
Conducted **motion capture, functional assessment, and sports performance analysis** projects.
Participated in **sports engineering and Sports-IT convergence research**, integrating biomechanics with sensing and digital technologies.
Supported experimental design, data acquisition, signal processing, and quantitative analysis for human movement research.
